GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field Two Wide 7l Held Up Turn 5l mare barges Through the tiniest of gaps Kept Going Soundly to score. great job 58kg # fierce will to win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from the 300m until improving into a neat run near the 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained 3rd Inside 3 Lengths saved Ground Turn Worst Going no match for those wider # solid Effort

Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths early 3 Lengths x 700m Good Pace on with 1st following 1 Lengths behind, Headed x 1st Straightening Up kept 3rd to the 125m then Couldn'T Go On - # had its chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 2nd 4 Lengths off Pride Of Jen, Fast Pace on, ridden quiet to 300m Soon After on terms hit Lead then 1st got it x 100m, 1st last crack this was # a sitting shot
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was inconvenienced and taken out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, battled on strong to the line without threatening # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To settle further forward; settled midfield. On jumping shifted out abruptly and bumped. Rdr reported the mare was stirred up prior to the race and he felt this impacted on its closing effort.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Restrained Settled Down well back 3 Wide 8 Lengths Out On A Limb Not Enough Pace On to assist, asked to go at the 400m ran on strong to the line - # very good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and then raced keenly in the early stages. Continued to travel keenly when required to race wide and without cover through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 3r d/4th Inside 1st 3 Lengths held together same to straightening up clear run home remained near to winner to 100m then not quick enough but had all the feels of 'will be fitter for this run' - # Sound fitter
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated when closing off well he initially was content to maintain a position on the running rail, however approaching the 100m he did not feel as though the mare was letting down as well as he would have wished, and with the leader shifting in towards the running rail he made the decision to shift abruptly to that runner’s outside, whereupon his mnt changed lead leg and closed off strongly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down Just Off Mid-Field 3 Wide with a trail 6 Lengths Good Pace on, Hard Ridden Straightening Up home in between runners truly Clear x 200m, ran on to the line - # Sound eff/finale
